_why: Both identity arms in one entry, across two nodes, plus the four features archived issue 0302 records as having reached the proc-macro and not the emitter: params (phase-264 W4a), identity (phase-268 W1), remaps (phase-305 W3), QoS overrides (issue #52). The greeting value carries a quote AND a backslash on purpose: quoting is the half that stays in each pack, so it is the half most likely to diverge.
